meta: The last part of "AI and your job", and a wrap-up of three series: "Inside AI's brain" (8 parts), "Your own AI assistant" (6 parts) and "AI and your job" (5 parts), as a 90-day plan.
prompt: How up to date is your knowledge?

muc.title: A 90-day roadmap
muc.text: The last part. We put all three series into a 90-day roadmap that takes just 15 minutes a day.

muc.title: Understand AI
muc.text: Month 1: understand AI. Rewatch the "Inside AI's brain" series and try two tips each week, like putting your request first, turning on web search for news, and using thinking mode for hard questions.

muc.title: Build your own assistant
muc.text: Month 2: build your own assistant. Write custom instructions, make a prompt library, create a project for your main task, and set up a scheduled task.

muc.title: Bring AI into your work
muc.text: Month 3: bring AI into your work. Pick three repeated weekly tasks to hand to AI, practice being AI's boss, and update your resume with new skills.

muc.title: Track your progress
muc.text: Each week, write down how much time AI saved you. Watching that number grow keeps you going.

muc.title: Start today
muc.text: Save this roadmap, and pick the smallest task to do today. Start small, but start now.

muc.title: Thank you
muc.text: Thank you for coming along for all 19 parts. If you just got here, start again from part 1 of "Inside AI's brain".
